name: SocialStringSet
summary: One string-set member of the Social replicated state in the client reader's element-count-zero branch: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many prefixed strings. The non-zero branch is the client's masked map of id to string; no recorded body takes it, so the card pins the count to 0 and refuses anything else.
purpose: Name the member layout the Social presence mask selects for `friends` and `friendInvites` (group 1 members 4 and 5 of codec.social-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint count 0x1417b4250 reads before it branches. It is 0 in both measured bodies, which select the reader's +0x78 branch 0x1417b54c0; the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance in the recorded bundle, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else instead of inventing the layout.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x1417b54c0: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Measured 01 07 (delta 7) in both bodies. The writer delta-codes it against the previous element; what the delta indexes is not established.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint count and that many prefixed strings, read by 0x1415c6fa0 through 0x14087a570. One 36-byte string in `friends`, none in `friendInvites`.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-4176.hex: friends is 00 01 07 01 24 followed by 36 zero bytes; friendInvites is 00 01 07 00. Both re-encode byte-exactly through the generated codec.
Member reader 0x1417b4250 and its zero branch 0x1417b54c0, whose second reader 0x1415c6fa0 reads the prefixed strings through 0x14087a570 (build 30fe6461).
